title: Orthonormal basis of ℝ^P adapted to the splitting V ⊕ V^⊥
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ and let V ⊆ ℝ^P be a linear subspace (V : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) with orthogonal complement V^⊥. Then there is an orthonormal basis e_0, …, e_{P−1} of ℝ^P, indexed by Fin P, such that for every i ∈ Fin P either e_i ∈ V or e_i ∈ V^⊥.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (V : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), ∃ e : OrthonormalBasis (Fin P) ℝ (Euclid P), ∀ i : Fin P, e i ∈ V ∨ e i ∈ Vᗮ
